name: Ruth
author: Not named in the text. Tradition has said Samuel.
date: Set in the time of the judges. Written probably after David’s rise.
setting: A family from Bethlehem moves to Moab and returns.
theme: God provides a redeemer for Naomi and Ruth, and through them prepares the way for David.

outline.label: Loss in Moab and return to Bethlehem
The nearer kinsman and the gate
Marriage and the birth of Obed

christInBook: Boaz is a picture of the kinsman redeemer, one who buys back what was lost. Ruth, a foreigner, becomes the great-grandmother of David and appears in the family line of Jesus (Matthew 1:5).
howToRead: Ruth is a short story with careful structure. Watch for the words “redeem,” “kindness,” and “refuge.” Notice how ordinary acts of faithfulness carry God’s larger plan.
